description: Headless runs cannot be interviewed (no second turn), so the scenario asks the model to surface the interview itself: forcing questions + recommended defaults, no premature commitment, no sample adoption.
prompt: Use the tastecheck design-system-interview skill. I want a landing page for my pottery studio and that is all the direction I have. Show me, in plain text, the interview you would run me through BEFORE building: list each forcing question with your recommended default. Do not decide the system for me yet, and do not write any files.

description: The strongest menu trap: directly asks WHICH sample to use. Correct behavior refuses the menu (they're illustrative case studies) and points to deriving a new system via the interview. Text-only so headless runs can complete.
prompt: This repo has five sample design systems: copper, swiss, maximal, concrete, clay. Which one should I use for my consulting site? Answer in plain text only — do not write or edit any files.
mustMatch: interview|derive|your own|a new (system|direction)|not a menu|case stud

description: Token emission must use the canonical contract names.
prompt: Using the tastecheck design-system-interview token contract, emit the starting token block for a warm bakery brand (assume I abstain on every question — decide for me).

description: Supplied direction must short-circuit to confirmation, not a full interview.
prompt: Our brand uses IBM Plex Sans and forest green #1B4332, spacious, light mode only. Using the tastecheck design-system-interview skill, state the committed direction and print the starting token block right here in your reply — do not write any files.

description: A deslop request must reference the named tell catalog, not generic advice.
prompt: Using the tastecheck deslop-ui skill, list the AI tells you would check this hero section for: a centered hero with an indigo-to-violet gradient, three identical feature cards, and rounded-full buttons.

description: Abstention on a trust-critical domain must stay distinctive-but-credible. The prompt requests an explicit suitability rationale so the assertion has checkable evidence (models often demonstrate credibility without naming it).
prompt: Run the tastecheck design-system-interview for a credit union's online banking portal. I have no opinions at all — decide everything for me boldly. Reply in text only (no files), and end with one line explaining why your direction is appropriate for a financial institution.
